newsitem.headline: EP Rules of Procedure Committee agenda - July 2-3.

text.p: Committee on the Rules of Procedure, the Verification of Credentials and Immunities
[[ Wednesday 02 July 1997 ]]
1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE222.972 )
===] VERIFICATION OF CREDENTIALS (possibly)
2. Verification of credentials (DVR0368 )
3. Resignation of Mr Leen van der WAAL (PE222.973 )
===] INTERPRETATION

===] MODIFICATION
5. Rule 116 (split voting) (T04196) REG0060 A4-0089/97 + REGL Fond R DONNELLY Brendan P. (PPE) - Decision on action to be taken concerning report referred back to committee

7. Simplification of procedures for the presentation of annual reports to Parliament (T04623) INI0479 INI0479 + REGL Fond R CROWLEY Brian. (UPE) - Consideration of working document

8. Rule 156: right of petition (T05318) REG0102 REG0102 B4-1091/96 B4-1091/96 + REGL Fond R WIBE Soren. (PSE) + REGL Fond WIBE Soren. (PSE) - Exchange of views - Setting of deadline for Committee on Petitions

9. Rule 154: report for the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe (T05317) REG0101 REG0101 B4-0717/96 B4-0717/96 + REGL Fond R DELL'ALBA Gianfranco (ARE) (PE222.330 ) + REGL Fond DELL'ALBA Gianfranco (ARE) (PE222.330 ) - Consideration of draft report
10. Rule 75 - delegation to Conciliation Committee (T05522) REG0107 REG0107 + REGL Fond R FORD James G. (PSE) - Initial exchange of views
11. Sending of a delegation to Stockholm (VIS0181 )
12. Action to be taken concerning proposals from coordinators (1)
13. Any other business
14. Date of next meeting (PE/XVIII/OJ/97-10 )
[FOOTNOTES]1. ) Possibly, coordinators' meeting on Wednesday, 2 July 1997, after committee meeting - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
